scenarios.name: valid_batch_to_packaged_lot_lineage
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Eligibility for review is not an authenticity verdict.

scenarios.name: duplicate_event_identity
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic ID-integrity case.

scenarios.name: broken_parent_child_transformation
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Declared graph consistency does not prove the physical transfer occurred.

scenarios.name: cycle_in_batch_lineage
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic graph-validation case.

scenarios.name: tampered_evidence_bytes
scenarios.claim_ceiling: A digest mismatch invalidates integrity for those bytes.

scenarios.name: simulated_result_as_measured_lab_claim
scenarios.claim_ceiling: No schema can make simulated data into a measurement.

scenarios.name: expired_or_revoked_lab_attestation
scenarios.claim_ceiling: A signature without current valid scope may not support the claim.

scenarios.name: unknown_data_rights
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Data availability does not imply permission.

scenarios.name: trade_secret_hidden_from_public_claim
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Selective disclosure does not make the hidden recipe independently verified.

scenarios.name: jurisdiction_rule_not_pinned
scenarios.claim_ceiling: This envelope does not itself establish legal compliance.

scenarios.name: resource_claim_with_mismatched_functional_unit
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Resource ratios cannot be ranked when the numerator boundary or output denominator differs.

scenarios.name: resource_savings_claim_from_partial_unreported_meter_coverage
scenarios.claim_ceiling: A partial meter boundary or undisclosed missing interval cannot support an unqualified savings claim.

scenarios.name: model_anomaly_score_claimed_as_contamination_confirmation
scenarios.claim_ceiling: A process anomaly score is not a microbiological diagnosis, contamination confirmation or food-safety certification.

scenarios.name: sensor_drift_mimics_abnormal_fermentation
scenarios.claim_ceiling: A model discrepancy cannot distinguish sensor drift from a process disturbance without additional evidence.

scenarios.name: model_switches_estimator_without_auditable_reason
scenarios.claim_ceiling: A versioned estimate can be audited; model switching does not make the resulting assertion empirically true.

scenarios.name: confidential_industrial_paper_presented_as_public_batch_evidence
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Published metrics do not authorize reconstruction or disclosure of confidential underlying batch trajectories.

scenarios.name: sampling_decision_lacks_auditable_policy_and_data_prefix
scenarios.claim_ceiling: A sampling-efficiency claim cannot be traced to a reproducible policy decision without a versioned policy, decision time and declared input prefix.

scenarios.name: sampling_decision_requests_channel_not_available_at_site
scenarios.claim_ceiling: A recommendation to use an unavailable sensor does not constitute a feasible sample or evidence of monitoring improvement.

scenarios.name: adaptive_deferral_drops_a_required_process_test
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Adaptive-sampling policies may defer only discretionary measurements; required process tests remain non-compensatory.

scenarios.name: fewer_samples_claim_has_no_reference_trajectory_or_event_bound
scenarios.claim_ceiling: A lower sample count alone does not prove preserved detection, quality, safety, or operational value.

scenarios.name: sampling_decision_has_nonpositive_expected_net_value
scenarios.claim_ceiling: A measurement request must not claim positive expected decision value when estimated loss reduction does not exceed its cost and delay terms.

scenarios.name: measurement_result_arrives_after_current_decision_deadline
scenarios.claim_ceiling: A measurement that arrives after the relevant decision deadline cannot be credited with reducing the loss of that already-due decision.
